The Excellence of Execution and the Hitman of the New Generation.

How Bret Hart connects

  • Character: Shawn Michaels — Shawn Michaels and Bret Hart's feud ended in the Montreal Screwjob.
  • Item: Intercontinental Championship — Bret Hart's Hitman peak ran through the Intercontinental Championship.

What is Bret Hart?

Bret Hart was WWE's technical ace of the early 1990s, a multi-time WWF Champion whose Montreal Screwjob exit in 1997 remains a company-defining rupture.

Key threads lead to Shawn Michaels and Intercontinental Championship.
